page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 128 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 128 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. This dedicated CPU allocation operates with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring consistent compute performance without the resource sharing typical of hyperthreaded environments.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput network operations. However, the instance does not include any local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage, and parallel processing workloads cannot leverage hardware acceleration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7.32xlarge offers a high-density resource profile for workloads requiring massive CPU and memory capacities without the premium cost of specialized GPU or local NVMe storage hardware. It is suitable for large-scale enterprise applications, high-traffic web serving, distributed caching, and database deployments that rely on external storage and require predictable, non-shared compute performance.
